folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B328: later corrections and actual absence mechanisms
folds.body:
All393 lines were content-reviewed: nineteen game-comparison groups, A2/A3, five world cards and contrast, E1–E8/N1–N7, both quoted user corrections, C/S/R/K/L families, bank/harvest notes and final director interactions. Preserve the chronological evolution. The later user wording explicitly replaces the at-most-one-world-clock idea with many clocks relevant to a life, distinguishes schedules from deadlines, and permits automated picking/selling and helping or hostile actors. Earlier E7, N5,24hour cap and harvest-is-attention-only statements are historical proposals, not current limits.

PartA's S means a search summary this session, with no page fetch and explicit low-quality/secondary or memory sources. It does not certify all named rates, deadlines, recoverability, closed-app-only behavior or default event choices. The sample cannot establish that hard dates are rare across games or that every serious effect is reversible. Source rules and exact original/expanded editions must be qualified before reuse. Five inferred world cards do not establish those NPCs, letters, rhythms or dose deadlines as current game/source mechanics.

Keep recurring availability, one-time occurrence, a true deadline, a committed job, an obligation, a world event and an observer's knowledge separate. Missing a weekly meal can miss an occurrence without deleting the next; a source event may happen even if this player is unattached or unaware. Lazy simulation and visibility budgets are performance/presentation choices, not proof that the world's unrelated causes stop existing. A few visible firm clocks must not hide a known material deadline or manufacture knowledge of a sealed one. One visit cannot establish an NPC's usual week without an actual schedule or evidence. Canon occurrence and its later discovery need their own dates.

The later pace-as-readout direction qualifies the fixed Village/LOTM/HP labels. It does not require a hard world-category floor or suppress consequences to fit a cosmetic label. Safe-idle/Calm, changed default routes and specific harsh/source modes need their actual selected clock policy. A hard event can have a genuine irreversible outcome where its mechanism supports it; the palette's guaranteed recovery, no closed life, no losses and permanent closeness floor are not blanket canon or body rules. The current generic human review gate is optional under AD42, while selected explicit source/choice constraints retain their scope.

Bank ownership is not identical to which world currently advances. Current journey-wide eligible-unused-time direction qualifies the old per-current-life accrual proposal; actual means decide where it can be spent and which world clocks advance. Uncapped storage does not require stale-rate decay, a sub-unit wage efficiency, soft friction, spoilage or a new penalty to replace the removed cap. Actual fuel, wages, food, stock, service access and supported delegation can constrain the work without an invented balancing tax. A source-supported free or broad method can genuinely remove a bottleneck. AD52 supports standing orders and routine compression while preserving real choice, materials, costs and time; a cart/stall/first-manual-run unlock is an example, not a universal automation prerequisite.

Hidden-tab activity, closed-tab absence, bank accrual and accelerated played time need declared policies. Equivalent supported elapsed processing should settle the same relevant state when that is the operation's contract; different chosen policies can have different outcomes. A day-sized fixed five-layer loop does not alone prove chronological correctness or long/split equality: a theft, delivery, decay, wage and choice can share or cross a boundary. Advance actual causal events in their declared order, reserve/publish once and preserve unsettled time on a stop. Summary coalescing may shorten text without dropping real consequences or transferring stock twice. A deterministic note alone is not a durable settlement proof.

Helpers spend their own actual supported time/means and retain agency, but a favor, gift or neighbor help need not always create debt or require closeness. Bad actors can have motive, means and actual evidence without the game announcing every secret intent. Guaranteed warning, absolute prevention by a lock, universal recourse and equal rewards for risk are proposals, not world laws. Random events still need actual causal preconditions and channels; an absence is not permission to invent a prior marriage, death, useful gift or anonymous thief. A return can truthfully show no change.

Favors, trust and a predecessor's bonds do not automatically transfer to an heir who is a different person. World history, a legal claim, a recipient's recollection and shared subject continuity need their actual carriers. In-world letters may disclose what their writer actually knows through an admitted discovery route; keeping sealed data private is not a ban on every discovered truth in a letter. The courier/return-note proposals authorize no external user notification or message. No NPC, schedule, clock, world source, source corpus, bank, save, event engine, message route or gameplay test was read or changed by this local review.
